name: The Langham Huntington, Pasadena, Los Angeles
positioning: Historic Pasadena hotel with garden grounds, a covered Picture Bridge and cottage suites, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles
best_for: Travelers who like a hotel with history and garden grounds
Guests wanting a cottage or club-level stay near Pasadena's museums

facts.text: The hotel is in Pasadena at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.
The covered Picture Bridge has been a feature of the hotel since 1932.
The hotel is set on 17 acres of greenery.
The Langham Club is on the 8th floor and overlooks the Horseshoe Garden, with views of San Marino and the valley beyond.
Guests of Club Executive Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.
Lanai Rooms have large French doors opening onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the historic Lanai Pool.
President Gerald Ford was a frequent guest of Ford Cottage.
Eastview Cottage was built in 1920 as a second home for Mrs. McNally of Rand McNally atlases.
Wisteria Cottage was built in 1929 and has a cone-shaped ceiling and French doors that lead to a patio.
The hotel's spa has treatments based on traditional Chinese medicine.

highlights.text: The Picture Bridge displays 41 replica oil paintings of California landscapes.
The hotel has been the setting for films and television shows including Westworld, Saving Mr. Banks, The Parent Trap and Modern Family.
The hotel's classic architecture and landscape were designed by the same key figures as the nearby Huntington Library.
The Tournament of Roses Suite is a two-story penthouse with views of the Horseshoe Garden, San Marino and the San Gabriel Mountains.
The hotel offers a quarterly interactive guided film tour through My Valley Pass.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Pasadena, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles, not in the city center.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
